name: smwmusic-mario-is-missing-snes-brazil-and-argentina-theme-arr
title: Mario is Missing! (SNES) - Brazil and Argentina theme arr.
description:
I've always listened this song and wondered, what would it sound if it were in a style similar to Super Mario World's Star Road theme

So I made my way to make this arrangement of the song

It contains 2 versions you can choose inside the mml/txt file
1 - Mario is Missing! Set (Default)
2 - SMW Star Road Set

It's the first time I make an arrangement of any song
and I like how it turned out
